column1: # variant<TAB>replacement, one per line. Hand-written fixes, built into manual_fix_rules.jsonl, which is applied AFTER the drug and term rules. Build: uv run 05_build_manual_rules.py
# lodose: decided in conflict_resolutions.tsv (read first, so it wins over a line here).
# 2026-11-18, owner: the surgical clip brand is Hem-o-lok in every spelling, plural Hem-o-loks. The
# -lok forms come from the conventions (convention_fixes.tsv); these are the -lock / -loc respellings.
# 2026-11-19, owner: Rio Branco, also when the model glues it and hyphenates the next word (riobrancho-dilatés).
# The end bound refuses a hyphen after a match, so the glued-and-hyphenated forms are spelled out (ending kept as heard).
# 2026-11-20, owner: misspelled dictionary headwords unified in the labels (label_conventions' OWNER_SPELLING_20261120
# and the re-synthesized typos); a model trained on the older labels still writes the old form. A hyphenated compound
# needs its own line (the bounds refuse a hyphen on either side). peroxisome stays (English in the labels).
# 2026-11-20, owner: fixes the v1 dictionary rule file had (lookup at 64b4642^) and the v2
# rebuild lost; sous-scutanée went to souscutanée there and on through the souscutanée row above.
# 2026-11-20, owner: Herpes gestationis / zoster / simplex keep their Latin spelling, so the generated
# convention row d'herpes -> d'herpès is switched off (an empty replacement takes the pattern first;
# the model writes unaccented d'herpes 4 times in the blend70 transcripts, 2 of them Latin).
# 2026-11-20, owner: nitro-imidazole stays without an accent, so the convention row nitro imidazolé
# is switched off too (the pattern ignores accents, it cannot tell the two apart).
# 2026-11-20, owner: ostéogenèse imparfaite fully lowercase. The elided rows come first: a bare row
# matched after d' or l' starts on the capital O and would keep it.
# 2026-11-22, owner: Diffuk, DiffuK and Diffu K do not exist, the only spelling is Diffu-K. The manual file runs
# LAST, so these lines also respell whatever a learned or imported (v1) rule writes ("diffu k" also matches
# Diffu-K itself, which it leaves as it is).
# 2026-11-23, owner: hand-found ASR errors (user list of 2026-11-23). Only the ones no current rule fixed; coroner, disney,
# rain, timmy, edem and "par soir" were left out because they occur in news text, "des cubitus" because it is
# correct in labels. Replacements follow the labels' spelling (quetiapine, pariétocolique).
